payload.title: Text-level coding filter for transformer backends and six-config study
payload.description: Add a text-level variant of the coding-domain neutralization for the transformer backends (applied to the stripped text before tokenization), make the filter a backend option, add a synthetic probe set (ordinary coding phrases plus genuinely negative same-word phrases), and extend the eval harness to run vader, transformer-sst2, and transformer with and without the filter: probe neu/neg split, tuning/held-out/combined accuracy, confusion matrices.
